title: Higher Security Bound for TNT-AES
summary: TNT-AES is proved secure up to 22n/3 queries, while determining a bound that reaches or settles its designers' higher conjectured bound remains open.

formal_statement.body: TNT-AES is a construction that uses 6-round AES as its building block. Its designers proved security up to $22n/3$ queries and conjectured a higher security bound. The unresolved task is to determine a security bound for TNT-AES that reaches or settles that higher conjectured bound, using a query complexity exceeding the proved $22n/3$-query bound.

scope.domain: Query-security analysis of TNT-AES, a construction using 6-round AES as its building block.
parameters: n: variable appearing in the proved 22n/3-query bound
Query complexity: the number of queries used to measure the security bound
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine a TNT-AES security bound beyond 22n/3 queries that reaches or settles the higher conjectured bound.

citations.label: Truncated Boomerang Attacks and Application to AES-based Ciphers

progress.summary: The source reports a proved 22n/3-query security bound for TNT-AES and records the designers' conjecture of a higher bound without presenting it as resolved.
citation_labels: Augustin Bariant et al., Truncated Boomerang Attacks and Application to AES-based Ciphers
